sentences.en: It is difficult to peg the direction of interest deregulation.
sentences.zh: 很难确定利率自由化的发展方向。

sentences.en: Hearing the monster's footsteps, they began running in all directions.
sentences.zh: 听到怪物的脚步声，他们四散奔逃。

sentences.en: We began to sail in the direction of the port.
sentences.zh: 我们开始朝着港口的方向航行。

senses.zh: 方向, 趋向, 趋势, 动向 - 方面, 范围 - 指南, 指示, 说明 - 管理, 指导 - 姓名和地址

mnemonic: 词根记忆：direct（正，直）+ion→直着走下去→方向
